name: Latitude II

management.summary: Split: Yelp highlights praise leasing staff for working with residents through hard times; older ApartmentRatings reviews say office doesn't follow up and cancels maintenance requests without warning. Operator not named on listings (lists itself as manager).

maintenance.summary: Mixed: some say work orders handled quickly and praise a maintenance tech; others report cancelled/ignored requests.

cleanliness.summary: Older reviews mention trash and pet waste left on sidewalks that never get cleaned.

security.summary: A 2018 review describes vehicle break-ins; no recent security data found.

pests.summary: Several 2015-2018 reviews describe cockroach problems; no recent confirmation either way.

costs.summary: No fee/RUBS/renewal-specific feedback found. Units renovated (stainless appliances, laminate floors).

praise: large units with lots of storage
complaints: severe parking shortage, essentially no guest parking
trash and pet waste on grounds
dealbreakers: Parking is the dominant, consistent complaint: realistically one car per unit and no guest parking. Historic roach reports.
recent_trend: unknown - most detailed reviews are 2014-2018; only a few 2025 reviews surfaced, and Yelp/Apartments.com averages remain low

name: Vista Apartments
management_company: Jones & Jones Communities (per ApartmentRatings 'who manages' field; unconfirmed)

management.summary: Recent (2026) reviews praise on-site managers by name (Andrea on Yelp, Shireen on ApartmentRatings) as easy to reach and on top of requests; manager replies to reviews are courteous.

maintenance.summary: 2026 reviews call maintenance excellent and quick; 2003/2008 reviews cited slow response and leaking pipes.

cleanliness.summary: Recent reviewers describe clean, quiet surroundings; little specific data on common areas.

noise.summary: Older reviews mention thin walls and street noise on Washington Pl-facing side; 2026 reviews describe it as quiet.

security.summary: Gated entry and package receiving; recent residents say it feels secure.

costs.summary: No fee data found. Note: 2015 reviews say no air conditioning.

recent_trend: improving - 2026 reviews are mostly positive while the critical ones date from 2008-2015

name: Garment Lofts

management.summary: Split: staff called helpful and responsive in some reviews; others describe an uncooperative attitude and a disputed, late security deposit return with deductions (2023).

maintenance.summary: RentCafe maintenance score 4.5; one Apartments.com reviewer says maintenance is fast, others report slow repairs.

cleanliness.summary: Complaints about graffiti in elevators and dogs walked through elevator/building.

noise.summary: RentCafe noise sub-score 3.5/5; Fashion District street environment.

security.summary: Controlled access and package lockers listed; no resident security reports found.

pests.summary: Aug 2023 one-star review describes cockroaches in common areas and units, with an extra/emergency charge for pest control. Single account, not recent.

costs.summary: Parking is extra (~$220/mo unassigned, uncovered surface lot) and often full; pest-control fee charged; deposit deductions reported.

praise: loft character, 9-21 ft ceilings, big windows
dealbreakers: Possible roach problem (one detailed 2023 review) and unreliable/expensive parking - ask about pest control and parking availability.
recent_trend: unknown - small sample; most recent Apartments.com reviews (2026) are from a single reviewer

name: Eleven Eleven Wilshire
management_company: Holland Residential (inferred from DRE license footer on leasing pages; not explicitly stated)

management.summary: Leasing staff widely praised on Yelp/RentCafe; but a Sept 2025 long-term resident review calls building and management 'disgusting' and questions authenticity of positive reviews; invoices called unclear.

maintenance.summary: Recurring building-wide water shut-offs (described as weekly for years in 2022-23) and an elevator out for months; some say repairs are prompt.

noise.summary: Construction/event noise; a 2025 reviewer describes weeks of nonstop jackhammering.

security.summary: Garage security concerns raised; VeryApt safety sub-score 6.4/10; neighborhood called 'not so great' though central.

pests.summary: One reviewer reports no pest problems; no infestation reports found.

costs.summary: A 2023 move-out reviewer says $1,800 deposit largely withheld for carpet replacement; fees not clear on invoices. VeryApt value sub-score 8.1 (rent decent for area).

dealbreakers: Chronic whole-building water shut-offs and elevator outages are recurring themes.
recent_trend: declining - aggregate scores still good but the most detailed 2025 reviews (CorporateHousing, ApartmentRatings) are strongly negative

name: Pegasus

management.summary: Leasing staff often praised on Yelp; a July 2026 ApartmentRatings review says emergency maintenance calls went unanswered and multiple residents posted HVAC complaints on the portal.

maintenance.summary: Recurring complaints: AC units that can't hold temperature (2026), window drafts, elevator outages (2022: 'only 3 of 8 working'), tiny in-unit washer/dryers taking hours per load.

cleanliness.summary: Apartments.com one-star review cites poor upkeep; a 2026 reviewer mentions a sanitation incident.

noise.summary: Loud nearby construction reported; Financial District location.

security.summary: 24-hour attended front desk; no notable break-in reports found.

pests.summary: July 2026 reviewer reports a major roach infestation; Apartments.com review also cites pests; one 2024-era reviewer saw none.

costs.summary: Steep annual rent increases reported. Parking for only ~half of 322 units; 3-6 month waitlist, residents rent spots 2 blocks away. Equity Residential lost a $43M CA class action over illegal percentage late fees and faces 2025 claims over separate pest/trash fees.

praise: historic Art Deco building, high ceilings, natural light
dealbreakers: If you need parking: building parking covers only about half the units, with multi-month waitlists. Recent (2026) HVAC and roach complaints.
recent_trend: declining - most recent ApartmentRatings reviews (2026) are the most negative (AC, roaches, unanswered emergency calls)

name: mResidences Olympic & Olive

management.summary: Polarized: Apartments.com has 16 five-star and 6 one-star reviews. 2021 review criticized management for installing fixtures without notice.

maintenance.summary: RentCafe reviewer calls maintenance 'probably my favorite part', efficient and timely.

cleanliness.summary: A RentCafe reviewer says building not clean in general (unit, gym, parking, hallways); windows not cleaned (2021).

costs.summary: No building-specific fee complaints found; note Greystar paid a $24M FTC/Colorado settlement (Dec 2025) over hidden mandatory fees and faces a 2025 California junk-fee class action - expect add-on fees.

praise: pool, sky lounge, co-working, dog park
complaints: management changes in unit without notice (2021)

name: Be DTLA
management_company: Greystar (with The Souferian Group; took over Oct 2019)

management.summary: ApartmentRatings staff score ~4.7/5; managers reply to nearly all reviews within ~5 days; Yelp reviewer says new management significantly improved things. Older complaints attributed to pre-2019 management.

maintenance.summary: Maintenance staff frequently praised; a 2026 reviewer mentions a disruptive water-leak repair.

cleanliness.summary: Most frequent recent complaint: dog waste and urine smell on the 2nd-floor deck/common areas.

noise.summary: Noise sub-score ~3.5-3.9/5; 2025-2026 reviews report hearing upstairs footsteps/furniture (top floors poorly insulated), though others call it quiet.

security.summary: Safety score ~4.6 on ApartmentRatings, but a 2025 resident reports a garage car break-in and an apartment break-in, and no hallway cameras; package theft mentioned.

costs.summary: Parking expensive; renewal increases mentioned; Greystar's $24M FTC hidden-fee settlement (Dec 2025) suggests checking mandatory fees.

recent_trend: steady - reviews through mid-2026 remain mostly positive, with pet waste and noise as recurring gripes

name: 1400 FIG Apartments

management.summary: No resident commentary found. On-site manager listed. A Yelp snippet mentions 'CTM Apartment Services' but this is unverified.

maintenance.summary: No resident commentary found; on-site maintenance listed.

noise.summary: No resident comments; Apartments.com Sound Score 63/100. Across from Convention Center / Crypto.com Arena / LA Live - expect event traffic.

costs.summary: No fee data; listings have shown large concessions (up to 8 weeks free).

praise: rooftop lounge with fire pit and grills
next to LA Live / Convention Center
recent_trend: unknown - too few reviews; beware confusion with City Lights on Fig (1300 S Figueroa) reviews

name: Olympic by Windsor

management.summary: Leasing staff described as responsive and knowing residents by name; others call management unresponsive and say corporate-controlled repairs drag on.

maintenance.summary: Maintenance staff praised, but garage gate outages trapping cars and slow corporate-approved repairs reported.

security.summary: Most negative theme: easy unauthorized entry, bike stolen from 'secure' storage, inattentive guard, false alarms; residents want 24h security.

costs.summary: Nickel-and-dime fees: $75 lockout, $10/24h guest parking (separate garage around block), clubhouse $200/hr + $200 deposit; deposit withheld for cleaning/painting, photos only provided after lawyer involved. Parking not guaranteed.

recent_trend: unknown - newest detailed reviews found are from 2023

name: Las Fuentes
management_company: Unclear - formerly Greystar (Yelp 'Las Fuentes by Greystar' listing marked closed), current operator not confirmed

ratings.site: Yelp (Las Fuentes by Greystar, closed listing)

management.summary: Negative across sources; a 2016 review alleges a leasing agent stole rent money orders. Management appears to have changed from Greystar.

security.summary: Gated access listed; no resident reports.

pests.summary: 2023 ForRent review and 2023 Yelp photo captions report a rat infestation; 2019 review cites pests.

costs.summary: Non-refundable 'Deposit IQ' fee reportedly then charged against damages (2023). Santa Ana rent control applies.

dealbreakers: Rat infestation reported in 2023 (review + Yelp photos). Verify current pest status and who manages before considering.

name: South Park by Windsor

management.summary: Yelp reviewers praise staff and resident events; ApartmentRatings complaints about office responsiveness.

maintenance.summary: Frequent elevator breakdowns (one reviewer trapped 3 times), hallway AC problems, maintenance delays.

noise.summary: RentCafe noise sub-score 4.0; few noise complaints.

security.summary: Package theft described as rampant in mailroom and garage; package lockers often broken (2025 review); packages found dumped in stairwell.

costs.summary: No building-specific fee feedback; listings show big concessions (up to 3 months free).

praise: pool, theater room, rooftop, conference room
dealbreakers: Package theft and elevator reliability are recurring (including 2025 reviews).
recent_trend: steady - complaints from 2022-2025 repeat the same package/elevator themes

name: Lake Dianne

management.summary: Recent reviews praise friendly, accommodating management and staff by name (e.g., Patrick); occasional confusion over charges mentioned.

maintenance.summary: Staff described as quick to respond; some repair delays; an older review describes a makeshift mold fix.

cleanliness.summary: Grounds and lake/water feature with ducks praised.

noise.summary: Described as serene and quiet; some noise mentioned in RentCafe complaints.

pests.summary: Cockroach reports in older (pre-2022) ApartmentRatings reviews.

costs.summary: Older reviews complain of ~$101 water/trash bill allocated from a single master meter (RUBS-style). Rents above Santa Ana average.

praise: quiet, serene grounds with lake and ducks
recent_trend: improving - 2024-2025 reviews mostly positive while harsher reviews are older (2006-2022)
